summary.name: Breeze Assistant
summary.one_liner: HubSpot's AI assistant that answers questions, creates personalized content, and builds agents using your CRM data.
use_cases: building AI agents on company data
onboarding new hires to company brand voice
summary.what_it_does: Breeze Assistant is HubSpot's AI assistant, described as free for every team. It answers questions using CRM data from the user's HubSpot portal. It creates personalized content and can be used to build agents. The page includes a customer quote saying the assistant knows the company's portal and marketing brand voice, which helps new hires get up to speed. The page does not give detailed technical specifications.
notable: Works from CRM data inside the HubSpot portal
Knows company brand voice, per customer quote
caveats: Page text is mostly marketing; no pricing tiers, limits, or technical details are given
Used inside HubSpot, so it depends on having a HubSpot account and portal
